name: blockchainlab-lens
summary: One-click explainer for Etherscan-family and Blockscout explorers: a Manifest V3 extension and a bookmarklet that open the matching blockchainlab-tools page. Its URL detector (`extension/detect.js`) is a reusable UMD module.

inputs.name: explorer URL or text
inputs.description: tx hash, address, ENS name or calldata; explorer page URLs on the supported Etherscan-family and Blockscout hosts

outputs.name: tools deep link
outputs.description: blockchainlab-tools tx/address/abi page for the right chain

compatible_with.how: every explanation is a tools page
use with API data in dashboards (Build with Blocks recipe 3)
same deep links in MCP results

tests.command: pip install playwright && python -m playwright install chromium && python test_extension.py
